text_block_list.text:
Fans go wild for Нарита Брайан after she
takes the
Satsuki Sho, certain she can
become the next
Triple Crown
Champion. The impact also spreads
to
the other racers in her year.

Нарита Брайан feels an elation
unprecedented for
her after learning
that there are other exceptional
racers in
her year.

We decide to run in the second race of
the
Classic Triple Crown—the Japanese
Derby.
